description:
Can you notice the clue hidden in the picture?

Even when you think you have looked carefully, something unexpected may still be easy to miss.

Phantom Thief Mirage and the Curious Clues is a visual puzzle game where you examine one illustration and choose the place that answers the question. Each puzzle is a self-contained challenge with no complicated rules.

How to play:
・Read the question
・Examine every part of the illustration
・Choose the place you believe is the answer

That satisfying flash of insight comes when you find the right spot! Even a wrong guess may lead to a fresh discovery when you take another careful look.

Challenge yourself at your own pace, or ask family and friends, “Where do you think it is?” and search together.
